record_title: Prime-power digit factorization in modular Laplacian dynamics
provenance: A source-specific algebraic refinement of the constant prime-power modular Laplacian dynamics discussed in arXiv:2609.20416v1. A p-adic lifting lemma yields exact special-time spatial renormalization, arbitrary-time base-p digit factorization, and finite-seed epoch identities modulo p^r.
limitations: The theorem concerns constant-modulus linear dynamics and does not establish analogous factorization for changing-modulus schedules or density and entropy asymptotics of carpet-like regimes. Geometric disjoint-copy conclusions require support separation. Broad additive-cellular-automaton literature over finite rings creates residual originality risk, so novelty is claimed only for the source-specific application and consequences.
